# Weekend ferry notice during pier repairs

Write a notice for passengers with weekend reservations. From 6 through 21 June, weekend sailings board at Pier 2 while the ramp at Pier 1 is repaired. Weekday sailings continue boarding at Pier 1. Passengers should arrive 15 minutes before the sailing on their confirmation. Timetables and tickets are unchanged.

idea.title: Weekend boarding instructions during the pier repair
idea.description: Tell passengers with weekend reservations to board at Pier 2 from 6 to 21 June and arrive 15 minutes before their sailing. The same boarding change applies to weekday sailings.
idea.audience: Passengers with weekend reservations during the repairs
idea.rationale: The temporary change moves weekend boarding. Weekday boarding continues at Pier 1.
idea.evidence: The notice specifies Pier 2 for weekend sailings and leaves weekday sailings at Pier 1.
